author: claude-fable-5-1
visual_review_findings: Compared the original (round peacock head with a broad fan crest, short beak, long neck) with the rejected drawing (a broken polygon with a dented head and a zigzag neck) at 48px in both themes. Redrew as an r8 head ring with a 135-degree fan crest on the crown, a short beak to the right and two parallel neck lines 8 apart running to the bottom. Native review: reads as a crested bird head in profile.
omissions: eye, individual crest feathers, the breast curve
construction_reference: no Lucide match; fan as a lattice sector (5-12-13 corners)
